gloss: to offer, to make an offering

definitions.gloss: to offer, to make an offering (to gods, ancestors, the deceased)
definitions.explanation: To present food, flowers, or other items as a religious or memorial offering, typically placing them at an altar, grave, or shrine.

examples.japanese: {仏壇|ぶつだん}に{花|はな}を{供|そな}える。
examples.english: Offer flowers at the Buddhist altar.

examples.japanese: {墓|はか}に{線香|せんこう}と{果物|くだもの}を{供|そな}えた。
examples.english: I offered incense and fruit at the grave.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}、{神棚|かみだな}に{水|みず}と{米|こめ}を{供|そな}えるのが{日課|にっか}になっている。
examples.english: It has become my daily routine to offer water and rice at the household Shinto altar every morning.

notes:
An ichidan verb. Not to be confused with the homophones {備|そな}える (to prepare, equip) or {具|そな}える (to possess, be endowed with), which use different kanji and have different meanings. The particle に marks the place or entity receiving the offering, while を marks the item being offered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{仏壇|ぶつだん}に{供|そな}える (offer at the Buddhist altar)
・{墓|はか}に{供|そな}える (offer at a grave)
・{神棚|かみだな}に{供|そな}える (offer at the household shrine)
・{花|はな}を{供|そな}える (offer flowers)
・お{供|そな}え{物|もの} (offering, oblation)
